The spy is heavily wounded, so you should go easy on him, but he must answer your questions!
The machine is buzzing. Sparks are running over its surface.

Hello there. Are you looking for something cheaper than the Soldiers of Fortune's Quartermasters? Then you have come to the right place!
The battleground is a dangerous place, and it often happens that people are carried off feet first. And their clothes are sold off cheap, to cover the funeral costs. True, the clothes are largely cursed, but the price is half of what the Quartermasters are charging for the same item. And it's no problem to get rid of curses if you use Purifying Scrolls!

But never mind, let’s get down to business. Compasses are hard to get. I can sell them to you for a small price. I’ve been places and I’ve had enough of those.
Don't be too hasty, my friend. I see scars on your souls, you've been through much... Let me help you.

Folios of Sparks won't grant you any extra Experience on top of the limit.

However, Spark Experience granted for Pilgrim and Spiritual Adviser talents can go beyond the limit.
Are you sure you want to redistribute Spark Talents, child? You will not be able to reverse that decision.

wants a good fight at the arena? You think you're so cool? We'll see that!

Go to the Battlegrounds and show what you're made of!

Aho, warrior.  is a frequent guest at our arenas! Maybe, you want to prove that you are the best, zoor?

If it so, the Battlegrounds are waiting for you. Fight with honor - or bite the dust, eysh!

Yes, I remember you. Your fights are quite memorable!

Well, I have some special rewards for you. Choose wisely!
Take your pick! Our artifacts might not be the best, but we always have them in stock!
We have everything for the heroes that help the people of Sarnaut fight off the threats of the unexplored Astral.
We have everything for the heroes that help the people of Sarnaut fight off the threats of the unexplored Astral.
We have everything for the heroes that help the people of Sarnaut fight off the threats of the unexplored Astral.
Here is our hero, a participant of the Great Balls and the most carefree creature in all of Sarnaut. Aren't you tired of chasing lovers and riding hares?
The portal hums quietly and surprisingly evenly.
The portal systems are in motion...
The portal hums quietly and surprisingly evenly.
The portal systems are in motion...
Yes, it took us all a lot of effort... I feel sorry for those who were left behind.
But we hardly have the strength to fight those behind it. These demons look larger and more formidable than those we have met before. My strength is already running out, and so is yours...

Yes, I remembered everything. Three levels of protection. Removing each level will draw attention to us.

At each stage, you must enter the correct characters from left to right, and the remaining characters change every few seconds... Clever, but not enough to stop us.
Of course. I'll be protecting the terminal while you and this... Gort deal with the Citadel defenders. Everything is simple.
Then let's get started... I feel uneasy in this place.
The terminal seems to be waiting for your actions...
Systems operate at their full capacity!

The truth is, Suslanger is my homeland. I just needed to find something here on Gipat.

Like many of my brethren, I went through the portal on Suslanger and ended up here.

So I know exactly where this portal is. One of the bridges in the mountains leads to it - you've probably seen them, right? But you can't reach it on your own. There's a special place nearby that can help you get there.

Let's meet there, I'll show you how to reach the portal.
We just teleported from there. Nihaz didn't even try to stop us. Perhaps he was too busy.

It's unsurprising. I'll explain: we were looking for the coordinates of... my mother's world. And we found them.

No, it's not about my feelings. Nihaz can't get his hands on another god's powers! Right now he's trying to invade her world. But now we have the coordinates, too...

The things I showed you happened a long time ago. We haven't been sitting idly in the meantime. We all have reasons to travel to another world.

Catherina dreams about progress. This project is just another accomplishment for her.

The elves are looking for the Beauty. They have seen everything in this world, so why not look somewhere else?

Aidenus and Yasker are looking for means to defeat Cosmos. The willful Aoidos and his ability to interfere in the course of history make them tremble with fear. But the Gates can pierce not just space, but also time. And even protect time from the Observatory's meddling.

We already had the Gates project. On Ferris. The loophole that led to Fractal is closed now, just like the rift on Dane. The Gates-2 project also failed. The island is under quarantine after the failed attempt to change the past by preventing Tep's Plague.

It's time to put together everything we know and can. And make a successful attempt this time, since we know the coordinates of the time and place where we need to be. To create Gates-3.

Of course. We were naive to believe Nihaz wouldn't try to stop us.

Suslanger was chosen as the site for the construction of the new Gates.  Why? On the one hand, it's a rather deserted place, and on the other, it's under the protection of the Empire and its fleet.

Construction proceeded in record time. However, one day an incident occurred at the site. Most likely sabotage.

After that mysterious event, an anomaly appeared around Suslanger. Remember when Ammer appeared? The first few months, an astral storm was raging around it. It was the same there. The allod itself is intact, but the portals don't work, and ships can't reach it.

That's why we need your help. You are strong enough to return if anything goes wrong. After all, you managed to escape Tep's illusion.

I have an idea. The thing is, your ordinary portals were created by modern spells designed for a world divided into allods. That's why astral storms can disrupt their functionality.

But June portals are different. They have a different principle of operation, and they can function even during a storm. There was a portal like that between Gipat and Suslanger... We need to find it, it's somewhere in these mountains.
Perhaps the locals might know something?
Ha ha! I'm kidding! Who needs that nonsense? Go stand in the center, and I'll say the right words - you'll be off in no time...

About what?

Ah, you mean this place! What can I say? I'm not sure where we are right now. I'm a simple guy from a village, and there's something humming and glowing here... I have no clue!

Now if you wanted me to cut someone down... I'd lodge an axe between their eyes! Now that's fun!

I just don't understand. We keep walking, but everything looks the same. You enter a door but end up where you stood before. It's some kind of sorcery!
Wow, another glorious battle! I could use a break...

We've been wandering through endless identical levels and corridors for months...

If I understand correctly, this Citadel is manipulating space... It folds it like a sheet of paper... Nihaz's Box that has one double bottom after another.

What are we looking for? Only you know that, Klavdia. It looks like the center of... this web.
This Citadel is bigger than I could have ever imagined...

Not to send you to another Ball, don't even think about it.

We have a difficult task ahead... Perhaps the most difficult thing you've ever had to do.

End Nihaz once and for all. How? Well, let's just say there are ways.

...But first you need to know what I found in the Citadel.

Listening?

There's a better way. After all, I'm not a bard to tell you long stories... And I can't rhyme at all.

Let's do it this way - I'll show you my memories. It will look no different to reality to your weak mind, no offense, which should save us both time and energy.

Let's start now. Shall we begin?

Ugh... It's all very simple: our memories are weak reflections of the reality we know, but it's different with gods. Without going into detail: my memories will be like an incredibly realistic dream to you. The difference is that this dream is controlled by me, so I can easily and quickly convey to you all the important thoughts and emotions. Let's start already...

Ah, good to know that Celie doesn’t shirk her duties. I’m Ereba, pleased to meet you. I asked our Domina of Life to guide here people who have... special powers. You, my friend, have a fragment of the essence of Sarn himself. Whether it’s good or bad... is up to you...

The story of that demiurge is full of contradictions and, to put it mildly, dubious decisions. But you should remember that your will is your will, and it’s the only thing guiding your powers. Sarn’s legacy does not define you.
Demons are probably closer to the Aoidoi than anyone else in this world. It’s our sacred duty as scientists to study this connection and uncover its magical potential.

We do not know that... Yet. Your power is akin to astral itself. Perhaps some creatures born in its depths have similar abilities, and now they are manifesting in us. We are the descendants of the Creator, after all.

No one but us blacksmiths can make plate armor. Also, we possess the art of forging rings. But first you'll have to practice making shields and various household implements.
Now, to the craft. Use a mobile forge to learn the list of blueprints available and prepare the right components. You can buy coal for your work from me. Use a pick to extract ore that should then be cast in the molds you need. As for rivets, chains, heeltaps and spikes, those can be obtained by fighting enemies.
The forging process is simple: you create five parts, check their quality, keep the good ones and reforge the rest. You can only reforge each part twice, and you work on at least two parts at a time.
If all parts are of equal quality, you'll get an item of that same quality. If the quality is uncommon, you'll even get two items. If not, you'll get the item anyway, but it won't be as good as it could be.
You'll gain experience for each item you craft. When you've gained enough experience, your skill level will increase and new blueprints will be available to you. The highest available skill level in blacksmithing equals your character level.
Keep in mind that, as your skill level increases, you only gain access to the simplest blueprints that allow making items for personal use. But there are other, more sophisticated and expensive blueprints that you'll have to buy or obtain by yourself. They will allow you to craft items for sale to other heroes, higher-level items or even relics. Also, we can create tools to work with equipment pieces and staples - you will need those at the highest development level.
By the way, if you ever need low-level components, you can use retroform that you can buy from me as well. Don't worry, a single vial will last for a while. Keep in mind, though, that retroform affects neither ore nor the goods made from it.

The result largely depends on how lucky you are. If you are lucky, you'll make an item of rare or even epic quality. Some tricks of our craft will let you considerably increase your chances.
If you got away with a smaller number of reforges, the leftover material will be enough to make an extra item of the same quality.
You can try making epic items or craft 2 to 3 uncommon items at a time, or you can choose the golden mean and get a pretty good chance to make rare items. Every blacksmith decides for himself as to which strategy to choose.
You will need a set of tools for your work. You can buy them all from me.
Here you are! You can always ask for more, if you need.
What designs would you like to buy?

The fire in the furnace in my forge shop never goes out, for so many creations of bronze and steel are yet to see the world! Every piece of armor, forged by me, can save someone's life.

Do you want to learn more about blacksmithing?

Not everyone is able see it, but miraculous powers can be found in every corner of this world. Look at this gray flower. It may not be as beautiful as other flowers, but its petals cure diseases and grant sleep to the feverish. Every herbalist knows that you can find healing force even right under your feet.

Do you want to learn more?

Of course, skinning innocent animals is not a pleasant thing to do, but that's the price we pay to create elegant armor and beautiful clothes.

If you wish, I can teach you leatherworking.

The real tailoring master makes clothes that accentuate the natural beauty of the body.

I must say I have achieved a certain proficiency as a tailor, and I should no longer keep my secrets to myself. The more people learn how to make clothes, the more beautiful the world is!

Every weapon is an extension of a warrior's hand. And a warrior's hand is an extension of their will. I make all sorts of weapons to make sure the strongest warriors run this world!

If you want, I can teach you how to tame steel.

Oh, I know all about “Daddy” and his tricks. Are you sure it’s not a ruse?

At any rate, you have changed our future before. You saved the Skulnar, didn’t you? You did. Saved Kirah? You did. Fooled the Architects in Dane? Yes. Whatever Cassandra says, you can change your destiny. I proved that myself many times.

The Well holds enough power to destroy this world completely - I am sure of it. And there is nothing we can do with it - aside from using it... And protecting it from our enemies.

The irony is that the person who can protect the world from a Cataclysm better than anyone is the one who caused it.
Balance is what is most important here. Before our world advances to a new level, we need to make sure it is stable enough. And ready to change. That is what we will do.

Such wars are normal for this world. Water flows, fire burns, and “sentient” creatures rip each other’s guts out for the greater good. I believe the Eclipse will soon start leaving the docks to set fire to some haughty king or another for daring to form a cult in their own name. It doesn't matter whether they are from the Empire or League.

I can’t say I like the idea of leading a crowd of loiterers, but who knows - maybe I’ll find a few skilled heroes like you among them or potential technomages? I could use those.

Technomagic is not the only key to future, you know, even if it’s the most preferable one. It would be an Order of Progress. We will search for optimal paths of development and fight those who threaten it.

Sounds pretty simple. Maybe it is.

Nihaz almighty! Can you imagine this arrogant duo as gods? And I’m fine where I am, too.

It’s more complicated than that - we want to channel this faith into an idea, not a person. You know what happens when an idea gains divine power? Well, neither do I. But I bet it will be interesting to see. I’m all for creating something new.

A little bit of this, a little bit of that. Restore the Allod from Purgatory. Create a couple of new civilizations. Keep an eye on those worthy of it so they don’t die too soon. Abolish Cataclysm. There’s always much to do - and if there’s a will, there’s a way.

Creation and destruction are two sides of the same coin. But lest we scare people off, we’re calling ourselves the Order of Creation.

Is that so? Interesting...

Of course, I’ll be there. So I could at least make sure this power doesn’t end up in the wrong hands.

A source of incredible magical power, hm? Well, those Aoidoi aren’t as foolish as I thought, if they decided to hand it over to someone more experienced. Tell them I’ll be there on time.

No go, I’m very busy.

I think you’re mistaken...

Your maiden is waiting for you on the Isle of Revelation, he he.

You need to understand that the Well of Souls is a source of incredible power that belonged to two deities. The League and the Empire are craving it - I can sense that hunger. We cannot allow such a weapon to be used in their war. But... you will need the power of the Well to fight Kyros.

The Council has made a decision.

We are willing to use the power of the Well if it can save our world. And we know only three people who are strong and wise enough to control it. I’m speaking about two great mages who helped us defeat Sarn and Architect.

Great Mage Zayan, the first Historian and the oldest sorcerer who dedicated his life to fixing the consequences of the Cataclysm.

Great Mage Catherina, the forerunner of Technomagic who once lost to Sarn and learned humility.

Klavdia Kalugina, who has an incandescent love for Sarnaut.

Such is the Council’s decision.

Not so long ago, a great battle took place in this world. The mortal people of Sarnaut set the mad Creator, Sarn against the distorted god Architect. Both fell in that fierce battle. The energy released upon their death was so great that it swept through the entire world and materialized as the Well of Souls. The Astral hastily retreated from it, and a new Allod was formed, one that we call Ammer. A few days later, the first Aoidoi came out of the Well of Souls.

The memory of this event awakens in each of us sooner or later. I guess you will remember it later.

Well, not exactly but you could say so. The Breath of the Creator gave us life, and the Architect’s mastery perfected our bodies. We don’t get affected by many diseases that plague other inhabitants of this world, and our tough skin can withstand a bite or scratch and can endure severe frost and unbearable heat. That allowed us to survive in the dark space that surrounded the Allod in the first days of creation.

Later, we found out that there was something else - something left behind by the Architect. You see, all Aoidoi have a Talent.

I hope we'll find out soon. Finding yourself takes some time, but the result is worth it: everyone finds their place in the society and pursue their calling. Some, for example, specialize in sculpture or poetry. Others are born to become wise mentors. There also architects and seamstresses... It could be a modest gift, but it still a Gift.

Some talents are so useful for society that they dedicate themselves to serving their people. Those Aoidoi are called Dominae. Their Council rules our people, making important decisions on Forums. I am one of them. They call me the Domina of Life, because I can sense when it is time for another Aoidos to be born, and I always welcome them to our world.
I am a Crossing Keeper. Where would you like to go?
What can I help you with?

Perhaps. Perhaps not. You won’t know unless you try.

I have a minute free. Let’s find out if your soul can sing in tune with the stone.
Hello! A good day for sports!
Rest for now, and then we’ll spar. There’s nothing better than sparring!
Yes, good run. It’s unbelievable - the Well created you just recently, and you are already strong enough that you can outrun one of the fastest creatures of Ammer.
The Unicorn is ready to take off and waits for the command.

Have you ever heard... hic... mating screams of aviaks? No?

Well I just heard them.
Hello. How can I help you?
I have plenty of this stuff.
Did the dominae permit you to travel?
I am a Crossing Keeper. Where would you like to go?
Hello, friend. What is bothering you?

Yes, this is all I need. Wait a minute...

There you go!
Drink but don’t choke on it. Take it slow!
It doesn’t work. The man spits on the ground angrily and extends his hand in greeting. Suspicious.
Hey, hey, I give up! Ah, damn it, I forgot the flag in the tent...

Wait a second, so you understand me...? What is this place anyway? Damned elf told me that I’d get into your mind and establish contact with you. He never said I’d get attacked!

Imperial Sentinel Andrey Sechin, nice to meet you. Shall we continue our conversation somewhere more private?
Articulation and gestures indicate that this creature is trying to have a rational conversation. But there is a problem - you cannot understand a single word.
It doesn’t work. The man spits on the ground angrily and extends his hand in greeting. Suspicious.
Help! Anybody?! Franz, you bastard. Get me out of here!

Oh! Wow! So you can understand me now? Why did you have to beat me? And where I am?! I swear by Tensess, I’ll drag this cursed elf to Novograd and toss him off Aidenus' Tower a few times!

Ahem, please excuse me, I’m being emotional. League Defender Gostomysl Ranov. Very pleased to meet you and all that. Why don’t we go somewhere else? I feel uneasy here.

Well, since it’s your house, I guess we should explain ourselves. I think you know that lately Nezeb knows what has been happening in this sector. Even my grandpa never saw a storm like that - and he had a lot of crazy stories to tell.

That’s why when the storm passed, we mounted an expedition to see the place where the two gods had died. You didn’t have to be a genius to figure out that the League would be there as well, hoping to get their hands on something valuable... And we couldn’t let them. No way!
Do you get what I’m saying? Well, thank Tensess!

Hello there... Whatever you are... The whole world will soon watch over these lands! Which isn’t surprising - it’s been a while since anything like that happened in the Astral! The sky was lit with colors I’ve never seen before, and lightnings were flashing here and there. Wow, that was something!

Then it all went quiet. So we rushed there to take a look at the place where two gods had died. It’s not like we really wanted to - but there’s also the Empire - who knew what they would find there?

Telepathy is a gift that I share with other Dominae and with some of my students. No, we can’t read thoughts - just images and emotions, but even that is enough to put two and two together. Cassandra and Epius informed me that you’re on your way.

I’m glad it took you less time to get here than I expected.

Bloodshed. Death. War. You were born on a dark day, Stormbringer, just as predicted.

Kyros, my beloved one, is a strong warrior. He forbade me from following him, but now this troubles me, for I can feel he is wounded, and there is no one to help him.
We won! It’s time to return to the Refuge.

NSHU is the National Sarnaut Heroic University which teaches the disciplines required to become a true hero.

Although, of course, you can probably start teaching there yourself. After all, you've been through so much and learned how things work in practice... Now you can tell anyone what you know about the world.

So let me just mark all the courses as completed for you.
Greetings, Stormbringer! Today is the day of wisdom!
Philosophy, my friend Stormbringer! How not to get philosophical when gods themselves are your progenitors?

Hello, hello!

What was it... ? We haven't met yet!

Well, a degree in history... I think you've earned it. You've been a part of so many historical events, and you even know Zayan, so you can't possibly be completely ignorant in this field!

Needless to say, future generations will read about your deeds. But I still hope that your natural curiosity and desire to discover the next secrets of this world will continue to push you forward!

Oh, …

No, no... I don't know you well. I think it's the second time I've seen you.

Natural sciences! I guess you're an expert in those already. You've collected so many different samples of minerals, gutted so many animals, and studied loads of... excrements of modified tigers.

And there are still lots of discoveries ahead! But since you need a degree, I will give it to you, of course. You've earned it.

Philosophy, , is love for wisdom.

I think you understand why my people are interested in the various teachings that exist in this wonderful world... Every nation has its own philosophy. While the Xadaganians seek the meaning of life in serving the state, the elves see it in Pleasure. And the Thread that guides the Gibberlings? And the Pridens' Tya and Tyalla? I believe you're familiar with many of these teachings.
So I'm gladly giving you this degree.

Greetings, friend!

So on behalf of Zayan and the teachers of our university on Ammer, I solemnly present you with your honorary degree.

Metaphysics, huh. Well, you already know our world well. Of course, there are things you still don't understand, but at least you have mastered the basics.

Gods, astral... You'll learn more with time.

I think you're familiar with all that. So I will gladly issue this degree. You've earned it.

Greetings!

So on behalf of Zayan and the teachers of our university on Ammer, I solemnly present you with your honorary degree.

Natural sciences! I guess you're an expert in those already. You've collected so many different samples of minerals, gutted so many animals, and studied loads of... excrements of modified tigers.

I think you're familiar with all that. So I will gladly issue this degree. You've earned it.
Metaphysics is a useful science in this world where our views are shaped by events large and small.
The world around us will bring us many new discoveries, we just need to keep moving forward.
Really? You know, Sarnaut is big, you're a famous hero, you've been everywhere. Who knows where we could meet again.

History is an interesting subject, of course... Do you know the history of elves? But we are the most ancient people in Sarnaut, our kingdom Irene existed at the dawn of the human civilization... I'm sure you know that much at least.

So on behalf of Zayan and the teachers of our university on Ammer, I solemnly present you with your honorary degree.

You've been a part of so many historical events, and you even know Zayan, so you can't possibly be completely ignorant in this field!

Needless to say, future generations will read about your deeds. But I still hope that your natural curiosity and desire to discover the next secrets of this world will continue to push you forward!

Wow! Let's celebrate!

So on behalf of Zayan and the teachers of our university on Ammer, I solemnly present you with your honorary degree.

Have you ever flown a ship? And ridden a Lightning Bolt? Do you use Mana Batteries?

Have you ever broke into Nihaz's Citadel? Or taken down architects?

I think you're familiar with all that. So I will gladly issue this degree. You've earned it.

Oh, you're a clever one!

So on behalf of Zayan and the teachers of our university on Ammer, I solemnly present you with your honorary degree.

Anyway, every nation has their own philosophy. While the Xadaganians seek the meaning of life in serving the state, we elves see it in Pleasure. And the Thread that guides the Gibberlings? And the Pridens' Tya and Tyalla? The world is full of amazing things!

I think you're familiar with all that. So I will gladly issue this degree. You've earned it.
History is a great science. There's so much we still don't know about the world.
Technomagic pushes us forward, bringing us closer to a new world with every step.

NSHU is the National Sarnaut Heroic University which teaches the disciplines required to become a true hero.

Although, of course, you can probably start teaching there yourself. After all, you've been through so much and learned how things work in practice... Now you can tell anyone what you know about the world.

So let me just mark all the courses as completed for you.
Philosophy allows us to discuss abstract things, but without understanding them, we are blind.

Everybody has sinned. Even Tensess says in his Testament, that "there is no single creature in the world who never violated any virtues. May this not become an obstacle on the way to the enlightenment! Everyone can abandon the old sins and let the Light into their souls by saying: Nay to Evil, I Praise the Light!"

Here you are, you have come and said the words to receive the blessing of the Light. May those who was harmed by you, forgive you, as the Light has long done!

Go in peace!

Everybody has sinned. Even Tensess says in his Testament, that "there is no single creature in the world who never violated any virtues. May this not become an obstacle on the way to the enlightenment! Everyone can abandon the old sins and let the Light into their souls by saying: Nay to Evil, I Praise the Light!"

Here you are, you have come and said the words to receive the blessing of the Light. May those who was harmed by you, forgive you, as the Light has long done!

Go in peace!

Amazing times are coming, New Child. There’s no pure faith in you yet, but your time has not come to an end. You’ll live.

I’ll show you the Light.

Sentinel. Servant. Gatekeeper. No more, no less. As long as there is Light, I’ll be here as well. And while I’m here, there’ll be Light.

Tell me, New Child, are you ready to accept my Gift?

The ways of your people are unfamiliar to me, New Child. You are looking for a talent that will set you apart from them? Light and Immortality will be your talents, if you wish it. You will live for as long as you like. If your body dies, your spark will return to Sarnaut in another one. That is the order of things.

Are you ready to live, New Child?

So it begins...

I can’t say this strange power does not worry me. Everything in our world is bound together by the cycle of life and death, and it’s so rude to disturb it.... It sounds like violation of natural laws. But at the same time, I’m thinking about how practical this power is, and how it can fight demons without fear. We already have one immortal Aoidos among us - Kyros. I wonder if your Gift came from the same place?

About Kyros...
My friends are nowhere to be seen. They must have remembered they're mortal after all.

You see, even Sarn, as mad as he was, was abiding the rules. Among his creations, there wasn't a single mortal - and there were reasons for that. Without a defined lifespan and the rebirth cycle life just... stops. It doesn't evolve. Stagnates.

Take the Great Mages. So much power, such many years of age, and what good do they do? The world doesn't stand still; it progresses. Look at the League and the Empire! Immortality has plunged them into an endless war. You kill each other over and over again, and there is no end to it. How long do you think this war will last if they all suddenly realize they are mortal?

Now even the dominae want to embrace the gift of immortality, thinking it will help them somehow. I will not let my people follow that path. I will not let another war happen.

This is the mission of a Dominus of War!

Unfortunately, it is so. I am the weapon of Creation. In order to fight immortality, one must be immortal. Many things are predestined before we are even born - much more than you think.

I'm sorry though that it took Aellona's death to make me see the truth. She deserved a full life. You can't even imagine how much good and beauty she could bring to this world. And now nothing can bring her back.

But this is for the best. Now nothing holds me in this world. I can fulfill my destiny.

You still don’t understand?

I will destroy the immortality. I will strike at the very heart of the cursed Light. I will overthrow the Servant of Tensess and take his place by the gates. The eternal guardian of the border between the living and the dead... I will be the overseer of life and the judge. I won't let thousands of immortals deplete the power of Sarnaut, depriving it of any hope for development.

So be it!

Me and Whip were telling Aoidoi about the Holy Power and its miracles. About the mystery of resurrection and true faith... That is when those beasts broke into the village. I knew I was their target right away. The Aoidoi did, too, and they tried to protect me. But centaurs were killing everyone. Whip took down several of them, but then they started shooting... He covered me with his body.

Then they... took me away. They tortured me to make me tell them things they can read in any church book! About Tensess, about the Purgatory, about the Servant of Tensess who guards it. About our faith. Of course, I told them everything... Then they went away and left me behind. I was too scared to try and escape - there's a whole village of them here!

I saw an Aoidos among them. He was tall, blue-eyed, with stone horns...

You see, his words make some sense. The inhabitants of Sarnaut really do overuse their gift. Especially that strife between the League and the Empire is driving me mental.

But I'm really not fascinated with the idea of some troubled teenager guarding the Purgatory and deciding whether I should die for good or live on. We need to do something about it. I have an idea... However, we should settle that local issue first.

The centaurs have reached the Well of Souls and occupied it. As far as I understand, Kyros and his mysterious sorcerer are intending to open up a portal using the energy of the Well.

We should use their portal, too - of course, if we don't stop them before that. But first we will have a horde of centaurs to deal with.

As a reply, Ollum generates another train of imaginative thoughts. Here demons learn the culture of the living things, their language... Here they get rid of their ancient instincts, forced by Sarn on them... And here they leave Sarnaut.

Demons want to leave Sarnaut?

Ollum is shacking his head - that's supposed to be a nod. You see his request: he wants you to deliver the message to a "chief Aoidos".

Well... You can fulfill his request for now. You can kill him later.
Excellent. Now I need to concentrate...
Right into the city of the stone monsters? Oh my...
Right into the city of the stone monsters? Oh my...
Welcome to Polis. You are welcomed here.
What do you want to know?

This is not a simple question, but I'm ready to answer it.

The layer of Creation in which we dwell isn't subject to the laws of nature which control time and space. One of those laws is: time is an arrow which flies from the past into the future. Time is a straight line, and whichever two moments we take, one of them always precedes another. We cannot think of the Universe working any other way... But sometimes, it's possible.

After the death of the two gods, Ammer was born. Time and space were going wild, breaking all the existing laws. Time was spiral; it was a wave, a ripple on water.

And space was... Did you see that Astral storm? It was like the matter of Chaos falling into millions of shining pieces, with lightning bolts cutting through the sky and piercing the reflections of a thousand suns.

We were at the very heart of that storm.

It was a strange time, and we tried to sort it out all on our own. We knew the kernel of Chaos, for Sarn was its father. We knew how to protect our minds from it, for the Architect was our teacher.

Finally, we found balance and emerged from the endless wormhole into real Sarnaut. For you, that process took... less than three months, I assume? For us, it was several decades.

There's no point in fighting nature.  We could only wait and patiently arrange the chaos of time into the "arrow of time". We believe our birth was a natural reaction of the universe to a violation of its laws. Our purpose is to heal it. And our reward is life.

You may ask why we don't look combatant, and why we are all stargazers and sorcerers? The reason is that we had no one to fight. We were surprised by this gift - the ability to ignite the fires of war. And only when demons showed up on our doorstep, we realized what it was for.

Not everyone, but many. Some devote their lives to their gifts and serve their people. Like me. I can see the Threads of Fate. I make predictions by looking at the canvas of the future... I predicted your arrival, Stormbringer, albeit I don't know why you were given that name in my visions.

Some find their vocation in sculpture, for example. The beautiful statues of our city are their work. Each one of us have a Purpose in life. This is the legacy of the Architect.

Don't be afraid of this name. He once was a great and noble god. But then, just like Sarn, he faced darkness which he couldn't handle... and became corrupted.

We can see our path clearly. We all have our purposes, but we live as one.

Several of our dominae went to the west. Demons were seen in a dangerous proximity from Polis, and I can feel that something terrible might happen unless we interfere.

First, we must counterattack. Demons are aggressive and primitive, and this plays into their hands right now. If we throw them back from our border, we will win the necessary time. Then your people will arrive, and we will be saved.
Where would you like to go?
The east coast is way too dangerous right now. I can't sent anyone there without an approval from the dominae.
We're packed today. The League and the Empire must be fighting for another allod! Well, I can't complain.
Congratulations! You're our client number 10,000 today! You win a free resurrection! What are you waiting for, get out!
For the Light and the Empire!
Friend, it would be a great honor to fight alongside you! Let us burn the evil!
You see, I'd love to help you kill that demon, but my command would not approve of that.

A good fight is always a pleasure!

Don't think that I'm too old for that. These hands can still slaughter hundreds of evil creatures!
I would love to help you, but I can't battle alongside my enemy.

The last hope vanishes as soon as you touch the lifeless body.

Aellona is dead and gone.

It's the least I can do...

She died by my fault.

I am just a humble custodian of our residence. If you wish to learn more about our people, you should speak with the dominae.

However, I can tell you something.

Each Aoidos carries the memory of demons, stranger. We knew that one day we will have to face them, but still their invasion caught us off guard.

The magic of the Well protects this refuge from their claws and fangs. Demons can't enter this place, but anyone who steps outside the barrier will most certainly fall victim to Chaos.
My name is Aellona. I am a Domina - it is my title and my great responsibility. Why were you looking for me?

Well... Dominae bear a piece of the Creators' memory. We possess our knowledge right from the minute of our birth, and we also feel each other, wherever we are. So, we knew that you were coming. That's why we're just surprised, not shocked.
Kyros, my beloved one, is a strong warrior. He forbade me from following him, but now this troubles me, for I can feel he is wounded, and there is no one to help him.

Other Aoidoi do not approve of my passion for battles... But this is not my fault that the Creators chose to endow me with the gift of swordsmanship!

I can see you want to ask many questions. We should go back now and have a conversation over a glass of beer in the Refuge.
How can I help you, friend?
My head hurts so much... I remember there were demons, and we were fighting them, but after that - nothing...
Alright... Breathe in, breathe out... I'm fine, I'm fine now.
My head hurts so much... I remember there were demons, and we were fighting them, but after that - nothing...
Alright... Breathe in, breathe out... I'm fine, I'm fine now.
My head hurts so much... I remember there were demons, and we were fighting them, but after that - nothing...
Alright... Breathe in, breathe out... I'm fine, I'm fine now.
The Throne Room of the Dead City changed quite a bit over the summer...

You must be wondering what I am doing here. Well, just like every one else involved, I am very interested in the legacy of the fallen gods. Coming here in my true incarnation would prompt unnecessary questions, so I'm kind of acting incognito.

I supposed that after Sarn's death demons would break loose, and I was right. So when I noticed a large pack of demons heading toward this place, I joined the demon hunters who were chasing them.

This is it, basically. I would tell you more, but I'm afraid I don't have the time.

What am I planning to do? Well, have a cup of coffee, take a bath, listen to Etienne de Blizar's opera... But first I need to survive, because there are much more demons here than I expected. We barely survived the first attack. This place must be feeding them with some kind of power. I can only learn more about that if you helped me sustain that defensive barrier.

I can feel the echo of powerful magic coming from the north. I don't know who's fighting demons down there, but right now I could use help from anyone.
This dead fighter wasn't a hunter, but neither was he a demon. His body looks strange...
The stranger looks at you in surprise.
The stranger does not extend his hand in return. Looks like force is necessary...
Alright, alright. Just don't kick me!
There are spiders around here! While I waited here, I learned more about them than I ever wanted to.
You're... You're an entomologist, right! And tell Nezlobina that I’m alive and that I’ll visit her soon!
Hands off, you pleb! Great Dragons will come and take me away from this barbarian land!
Have you got any good news?
Mom, I said I'm not going anywhere! Let me sleep...
Just one whiff... Aaagh! Don't! Get off me!
It's still warm. It smells like regular tobacco, but there's also a subtle scent of rot...
Get ready! I'm opening the Portal!
Get ready! I'm opening the Portal!

My name is Amos, and they call me the wisest of Aoidoi.

Only time will tell if it truly so.
This is unforgivable... His impatience already killed Aellona. If we give him a free rein, he’ll destroy us all.
Wisdom is not forgiveness of all sins. I need to ensure my people’s wellbeing. And I don’t need Cassandra to tell me that Kyros is a threat.
Unfortunately, this moment in history couldn't be averted.

Did I foresee it? Both yes and no.

I could see the picture of the future, but I couldn't work out what was leading up to it. My gift is complicated, Stormbringer. I didn't think that any of the dominae is capable of treachery, for we can hear each other's thoughts. And Kyros was one of us.
I didn't expect that from our old friend.

It's our fault, too. We shouldn't have put so much pressure on him after his loss. If you want my opinion, what Amos said wasn't very wise. Kyros was looking for someone to put the blame on, you say? Wasn't it us who had just put all the blame on him? We got what we deserved.

I wonder what Kyros wants... I don't think he himself understands that. If he did, then we'd know.

Oh... I need a drink.
So Kyros turned his back on us all. This was very reckless of him.
Is everyone alive? Seems like that...

Kyros was always striving to devote himself to our people. Even now, in the hour of madness, he couldn't commit that terrible crime. But I'm afraid his future deeds will hurt not only us, but the whole world...
I remember the moment Kyros was born. He had such bright eyes. So much strength in his gaze...

Kyros is lost. I can feel his pain, his despair... This sense of unfairness sits deep in his heart. Without it, he wouldn't have his gift.

Aellona's death distorted that feeling. Kyros misses his beloved one but... in the end, he just feels sorry for himself and wants to blame it all on someone. It is easier for him to blame it all on immortality than on himself.
There are some trails on the ground.

It looks like this was a herd of horses. But not wild ones - the prints of horseshoes can be seen clearly.

And Aoidoi do not breed horses...
A long spear. Who it belonged to?
An intricate pattern can be seen on the shaft. The blade is rather rough and was clearly made by means at hand. However, it is sharp enough to pierce the skin of a wild animal.
This was clearly an attempt to make a magic circle out of some strange crystals.
The crystals are cold to the touch. Whatever magic they contained, now it's gone.

This allod makes me seasick.

And I have sailed all the three seas left in Sarnaut.

The Secret Paths. The forbidden layer of the Planar Rim. Even Great Mages don't know how to get there. That place is made of so many thin threads and matters that even a slightest interference can wipe out a part of Sarnaut. And maybe even other worlds.

And now Kyros tries to get there. I say "tries" because if he had already succeeded, we wouldn't be speaking to each other right now. I suppose he failed, and instead the portal took him to some other place. Not too far away, I guess. You should ask the dominae about that - we've got to make at least some use of their telepathy.

I'm very sorry, but I couldn't save that warrior. Eight arrows damaged his internal organs, and he had several broken and fractured bones. The arrows were also poisoned...

You can examine his body and belongings. Maybe you will find some answers. He died without regaining consciousness, so I couldn't ask him anything.
An angry expression is frozen on the orc's face. He must have been infuriated with the circumstances of his death.

Celestia has extracted the arrows from the body. They have the same kind of patterns carved in them as that mysterious spear did.

The huge hematoma on the orc's chest resembles... a horseshoe?

Whoever killed this orc, he must have also been to the place where Kyros tried to open up a portal.

The orc also has a blood-covered bag on him.

Box lunch and propaganda materials of the Trinity Church.

He must have been a priest...

Oh dear Nezeb... Yes, a reaver called Whip the Fiery was the bodyguard of preacher Maya Milostina. And she didn't come back either... Now I see why. She must have been kidnapped.

Our hands are tied! We're on a foreign land! Damn it... We must first settle it with the dominae.

It’s not the time yet. View the race schedule in the Calendar, Stormbringer.

The race starts daily at 11:15 AM; 2:15 PM; 5:15 PM; 8:15 PM; 11:15 PM.

You are going to be one of nine gladiators fighting at the Arena. When you inflict damage or defeat an enemy, you score points. If you are defeated, you lose points. Participants who score most points will take prize places.

Everybody is fighting against everybody.

Good luck!
Good day. A perfect day for some sports!

You are now registered as a participant!

You may have to wait for a while before your opponents join the battle. You can see the queue progress in the Skirmishes list.

Vigilant: cannot be distracted, cannot be sneaked by; one can only walk around his field of vision or hide behind terrain elements.

Keen: can be distracted but notices if one tries to sneak by him.

Absent-Minded: can be sneaked by but cannot be distracted.
I am in charge of the Labyrinth. You can come here everyday and make an attempt to pass the trial. Tell me when you’re ready.

You need to find three Aoidoi in the Labyrinth. To release them, you will need Crystal keys, so collect them on your way. After releasing the Aoidoi, take them to the central portal.

Don’t let the Minotaurs notice you! Every time they do, you will be fined. The less penalty points you have by the end of the trial, the more rewards you will get.
Before you begin your trial, let me explain the rules.

If only I knew, Stormbringer. Of course I tried the food first, even before the Domina, but as you can see I’m perfectly fine. How could poison get into the caldron in those two minutes... I’m sure nobody approached it! I take my job very seriously.
A shame! Shame on my art!

Both yes and no. I found the answer, but it only generated more questions.

I know it’s magic poison, but this kind of magic is unknown to us. With every minute, more and more soup in this caldron turns into deadly poison. The aggressive substance devours matter... and transforms it. The caldron itself is corroding - we need to find a safe place to contain this terrible thing. And I wouldn’t dare to pour it on the ground...

Cassandra is getting worse, Stormbringer. She’s still alive because she’s an Aoidos; our bodies are built to sustain poison. But she won’t last forever...

Here’s a poison sample. We need all knowledge that we can possibly obtain. Find the most experienced sorcerer that you know and show this thing to them! Hurry up!
I wish I could say “Good day”, but it’s not...

Damn it! Where did you get it?! Do you even know what that is? It’s Tangible Darkness, the Primary Poison!

What’s inside of this bottle wasn’t meant for the eyes of the mortal. It’s not even a substance, it’s... Nothing. It doesn’t belong to this world. It is the opposite of everything that exists.

Now when it’s here... and it took shape, because you can’t exist without a shape in this world even if you’re Nothing. Darkness... Could it be Nihaz’s villainy? But why? Anyway, now we need to decide what do we do about this thing.
Cheer up. The Aoidoi are being way too kind to us! You should enjoy it while you still can.
Cassandra lies still. You can see darkness sparkling under her eyelids.

Grr... Well, you are right. I am bound to fulfill my duty and help you... Let it be so.

I am indeed familiar with the Darkness. Dragon fire can banish it from our world. But since it’s inside Cassandra, my fire will also destroy her... Hmm... I will take a look at her and see what I can do. I can’t promise she will survive.
You again... I wonder why do we keep meeting.
The Observatory. My humble residence. You will discover more when the time comes - your fate is wedded with this place.

So Soliskar tied herself and Cassandra with bonds of life? What a sacrifice... And she did it because of her duty to you. Because you had saved her from the sorceress possessed by Sarn. Who had been, in his turn, imprisoned by Nihaz. And Nihaz, as Klavdia assumes, is responsible for the poisoning... The circle has closed, right? But something doesn’t add up in this story. Why would Nihaz do that? Why would Soliskar doom herself to dependence on a fragile mortal life? Because bonds of life (and death) are called so for a reason. This all is very odd...

Well, we’ll learn everything in due time, I suppose. Now let’s return to the Games!
Nothing! Things will take their course. I think Phoebus is done with his trial - you will love it! Good luck.

So you have swallowed the bait. Everyone - you, Cassandra, the rest of Aoidoi, the rest of Sarnaut... Nihaz got just what he wanted.

Yes, you understood correctly - I was the one to show him the way in. Don’t let your anger get in the way of reason - we are all Nihaz’s enemies, both you and I. His arrival will help us all, however hard it is for you to comprehend it. We desperately need to behold the power of the Dark God and realize our own futility. Because if we don’t see the terror which is upon us, we will never understand we don’t have the time for our petty strife.

It’s hard to talk bearing the weight of the times on my shoulders, Stormbringer. Let me...
We have the whole infinity of time... And we’re infinitely running short on it.

Me? But... I’m a musician, not an athlete. What’s the point?

Alright, I will do as you suggest. Maybe I will find some inspiration in it... Or not. But still better than idling around.

quests: Will to Live, Will to Win

t:
Oh, Stormbringer... Hello.

Not bad, right? The games, I mean. I wonder what it feels like to be an athlete.

quests: Will to Live, Will to Win

t:
Everybody’s going to watch me fail! No-no, Stormbringer, thank you, but I will just disgrace myself.

However, riding Amos’ chariots seems fun...

That’s incredible... There’s so many different creatures in the world. All have their own traditions and history... Own tastes and habits. And still they’re here to see the Games! Isn’t this exciting?

I wish I could participate but...

You will have to leap over obstacles. There are three types of them: low, high, and long. This means you can make three types of leaps: short, long, and high. Choose wisely!

Collect bonuses as you race. The more you collect, the bigger will be your reward. The trial is time-limited, so concentrate!

Are you ready?
Your goal is to find and release the Aoidos who is locked in the cage on the Labyrinth’s edge. On your way, you need to collect 5 cage keys and avoid the Minotaurs.

There are three types of them.

Vigilant: cannot be distracted, cannot be sneaked by; one can only walk around his field of vision or hide behind terrain elements.

Keen: can be distracted but notices if one tries to sneak by him.

Absent-Minded: can be sneaked by but cannot be distracted.
Be careful. Come again if you need to ask about the rules.

Great. Those were the basics.

When you come here again, the rules will be harder. You can tell Ionas everything went perrfectly!

Use the portal to exit the Labyrinth.

There are three types of them.

Vigilant: cannot be distracted, cannot be sneaked by; one can only walk around his field of vision or hide behind terrain elements.

Keen: can be distracted but notices if one tries to sneak by him.

Absent-Minded: can be sneaked by but cannot be distracted.

I will remind you what you need to do on our way. And right now we need to go through that teleport behind me.

Are you ready?

Oh, wonderful. The Labyrinth is almost completed, and we have one corridor ready for the test trial.

Your goal is to find and release the Aoidos who is locked in the cage on the Labyrinth’s edge. On your way, you need to collect 5 cage keys to unlock the cage. Avoid the Minotaurs!

Listen, I have an idea. A Spring Spirit dwells here on Ammer. Those springs hate dirt. If you let it know that these beasts are drowning in their own dung, it will be enraged... And rain all the cleansing power of nature on them!

You just need to make sure it doesn’t kill them. Sometimes those spirits can get carried away...
The sky is clear above this land, cuat.

Oh, they are charged with magic right now... This won’t be easy. They will try to escape, and there is no magical barrier here that can hold them! We must catch them before it’s too late.

There are three kinds of balls - blue, red, and yellow. There are a lot of blue ones, fewer red ones, and very few yellow ones. The blues ones are peaceful and slow. The red ones will try to kill you! And the yellow ones just like to fly around like crazy - it won’t be easy to catch them.

Ah, and take this rune. It will help you put the red balls to sleep for a short time - just to let you put them in the bag. Hurry up, Stormbringer!

In the first phase, you need to fly through the rings. It might seem easy, but it’s not.

In the second phase, you need to catch as many yellow and blue balls as possible. Each blue ball gives you 1 point; each yellow ghostly ball gives you 10 points.

In the third phase, you need to throw the balls - once through each ring. If you do it on your first attempt, you will score additional points.

Beware of the red Bouncer Balls! They will attack you and try to throw you to the ground, and then you will lose points and time!

The more points you score, the higher is your reward!
